post.description: Current operation eligibility, not an authorization token. Every mutation rechecks current policy. Exact requests include audience, original Ask, reverse response and conditions.

get.description: Own effective access, including direct/group role provenance. Inspecting another subject requires identity visibility and explicit view access:<subject ID>, or an administrator credential.

post.description: Complete bounded keyset reads with current per-record authorization. Continue until next_cursor is absent, including empty pages. Cursors are encrypted and bound to scope, actor, filters and limit for 24 hours. Message history requires conversation_id and is chronological; other collections use stable ascending IDs. Unsupported filters are rejected.

Non-sending preview of 1 to 100 explicit individual/instance targets. Includes native, primary, copy and fallback permission/enablement observations. Token binds the authorized audience and route revisions for ten minutes. Hidden recipient identities and addresses remain private.

Atomic explicit recipient dispatch, deduplicated by logical identity. Conflicting replica targets are rejected. Private conversations and per-target receipts; failure rolls back the entire batch. Optional preview token prevents changed routes/audience from silently proceeding.

Atomic private request per explicit target. Each request has an independent response and execution lifecycle; no implicit shared approval or first-responder broadcast. The nested request must omit target and conversation_id.

get.description: Supported providers and actual fields/capabilities only. Native inbox is built in; no planned integration is installable.
Non-sending configuration/credential checks for a scoped installation manager. Provider acceptance remains not_tested; no external network request is made.

post.description: Explicit durable test message to one configured destination only. Requires installation/destination management and Message permission. Queue acceptance is not provider acceptance. Inspect delivery evidence afterwards.

get.description: Current authorized request, paged delivery evidence and execution reports. Audience members see their own projection; requesters can inspect their outgoing deliveries. Provider acceptance never proves execution.
Authenticated scope, company, environment, deployment kind and schema version. Managed composition supplies deployment metadata explicitly.

Person-only scoped account access requires view account:workspace or an administrator credential. This entry point permits status inspection during service suspension with a still-valid credential and current account policy. Runtime-applied quotas/usage are separate from server-side managed requested/provisioning/entitlement state. No operator tokens enter the browser; managed read failures are 503, never zero usage.

post.description: Non-saving, version-checked role-edit preview. Same rule ceiling and assignment boundaries as SaveRole; reports exact affected assignments and before/after role-grant checks for authorized subjects. Administrator credential power and new assignments are not simulated. Other assigned roles remain effective.

items.description: Credential metadata only; no digest or plaintext.

post.description: Durably store canonical messages and queue deliveries. Prefer: return=minimal returns a compact acceptance receipt; it is not delivery or execution confirmation. Replay the same input and idempotency key without Prefer to retrieve the full result without resending.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Optional return=minimal; full SendResult remains the default.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: With stream=1, summary=1 omits event data while preserving current authorization, metadata and replay cursors. Full events remain the default.

post.description: Owner-controlled optional assistance. Both features default off. Enabling requires a configured provider.
Read-only structured fleet status filtered by current View permission.
Optional overseer. Acts only as the caller. Outbound messages, questions and tasks require a saved preview and explicit confirmation.
Read-only summary of currently authorized replies; changed permissions or replies invalidate derived output.
Atomically confirm a server-saved preview under current caller permissions. Idempotent per plan. No free-form targets or instructions accepted.

200.description: Authenticated attachment download, at most 5 MiB

SharedAnswer.description: Scoped publication with answer, author/publisher, audience, provenance, validity and invalidation.
